differences.title: Duplicate keyboardBacklightStates key in legacy serializer
differences.rationale: Legacy code emits duplicate keys causing parser issues; Rust implementation serializes valid unique keys with regression test.

differences.title: Missing SetWebcam method on DBus
differences.rationale: Legacy exposes WebcamSWAvailable and GetWebcamSWStatus but lacked SetWebcam; will add typed method while preserving old queries.

differences.title: GNOME Enabled vs Supported mismatch
differences.rationale: Legacy extension checks supported but treats as enabled; clean Rust adapter separates capability from active state.

differences.title: False positive bool return code on write errors
differences.rationale: Legacy sometimes returned true when IO failed silently; Rust returns explicit false/Result on write failures.

differences.title: YCbCr / YUV420 color format parsing
differences.rationale: Fix parser edge cases when detecting force YUV420 output switches.
